title: High Seat: token re-prompt (saved) then reload loses input — unusable
body:
John 2026-07-28 (main Anchor dashboard · High Seat / Ecgberht portfolio steward):

Also, a bug with regards to the High Seat. I just tried to give it input and it came back with asking me for the Anchor token, which I gave it (actually it was still saved--that may be a problem). Then it restarted anchor and lost/forgot what I had given it. So, we are not able to use the High Seat yet. I will take a look at the project level steward.

What happened:
1. Opened High Seat, typed / submitted input (speak / saybox).
2. UI asked for the Anchor access token.
3. Token was **already in localStorage** (pre-filled in the prompt) — re-prompting a saved token is itself a problem.
4. After accepting the token prompt, page **reloaded** (felt like "restarted anchor").
5. High Seat forgot the input entirely — dialogue gone; cannot usefully use High Seat yet.
6. John will separately inspect project-level steward; this report is **portfolio High Seat** only.

Expected:
- High Seat acts (speak / override / decide) must send auth correctly so a saved token never forces a re-prompt mid-conversation.
- If auth is missing/wrong: ask once **without** destroying the draft — keep saybox text + pending act across re-auth.
- Never full-page reload as the only recovery path for High Seat 401 while the user has typed input.
- "Token still saved but still asked" must be diagnosed: wrong token, header vs query, or false 401.

Code-backed (facts for sleep):
- static/high-seat.js: dialogue is **explicitly ephemeral** ("Dialogue is ephemeral"; close writes nothing; panel state evaporates). No draft buffer.
- High Seat uses fetch + ?token= via _ecgHsTok() / _ecgHsPost — not X-Anchor-Token header.
- anchor_gui global fetch wrapper: any 401 + ANCHOR_AUTH_REQUIRED → setAnchorToken() (prompt pre-filled from localStorage) → **location.reload()** — destroys in-memory High Seat UI + unsent/in-flight input.
- setAnchorToken always offers the saved token as default — matches "it was still saved".
- /api/ecgberht/high_seat* routes are AUTH_TOKEN (route_table).

Success criteria for sleep:
1. With a valid saved token, High Seat speak never prompts for token.
2. If 401: re-auth without losing the typed High Seat message (restore draft after auth or retry act without full reload).
3. Do not treat "token present in prompt default" as success — verify the request actually authenticated.
4. High Seat remains usable end-to-end for at least one speak → receipt path without page reload.
5. Document whether "restarted anchor" was full service restart vs page reload; fix whichever path wiped state (if service restart is also happening, journal that separately).

Out of scope this report: project-level steward (John will look); Ecgberht git/version friction 2026-07-27-02 remains separate.
